about_short_description.short_description: The only piece of software a coffee shop needs to operate.

product.name: Dripos Core Operating Platform
product.description: An all-in-one cloud-based platform for coffee shops that combines point of sale, online ordering, menu management, payments, customer loyalty, inventory, analytics, and multi-location operations.

product.name: Dripos Financial Management
product.description: Financial tools for coffee shops covering payroll, bookkeeping, accounting, tax filing support, capital access, payouts, and business reporting within the Dripos platform.

product.name: Dripos Team Management
product.description: Employee management software for hiring, onboarding, scheduling, time tracking, communications, checklists, performance reporting, and payroll for coffee shop teams.

product.name: Dripos Marketing Tools
product.description: Customer engagement software for coffee shops that supports campaigns, loyalty programs, promotions, coupons, gift cards, fundraisers, and customer email or text messaging.

product.name: Dripos Operations Management
product.description: Operational software for coffee shops that manages inventory, supply chain activity, invoicing, checklists, cost tracking, and connected sales and labor data.

product.name: Dripos Hardware
product.description: Point-of-sale and shop equipment for coffee businesses, including tablets, stands, kiosks, printers, cash drawers, kitchen display systems, barcode scanners, and card readers.
